summary: Both halves of the fix are real, traced and reproducible — I could not refute the core claims. The Creative Factory root cause is confirmed exactly as stated: shell.js:1201 does `var box = a.closest("li") || a.closest(".card") || a;` then `box.style.display="none"`, ROLE_TABS.partner (shell.js:369) is only partner-galaxy/brand-studio/social-studio/creative-factory, and the removed `campaign-manager.html` link sat inside the same `.card` (creative-factory.html:420) that holds `#genBtn` (:439). Removing the link genuinely restores the card. Social Studio genuinely now calls POST /api/social/posts, which is already keyed in ROUTES (netlify/functions/api.mjs:512) and does work with no channel. All 15 markers present, both files grew (2097→2238, 2206→2267), div tags balanced, inline scripts pass node --check, routes.test.mjs 15/15 pass, and I reproduced the 12/12 pg test pass against fundhub_t10_d. No -intended.md touched, no existing test modified or skipped, docs/END-TO-END-VERIFICATION.md untouched, no migration edited, no money column anywhere in the diff, no secrets or PII. The manifest's leftUndone and blockers are accurate — I verified schedule.mjs:32, generate.mjs:107 and that there is no INSERT branch in posts.mjs, and I confirmed the calendar-paint failure is brand-studio (sibling T11), not this unit. What it does not survive: (1) a genuine false statement to the user about a post going out, (2) a new empty-state caption that contradicts the unit's own known gap on the same screen, (3) test coverage that pins the server side only — api/social/posts.mjs is unchanged by this unit, so all 12 tests pass identically against HEAD and prove nothing about the fix. Not BROKEN; the defects are honesty and coverage, not breakage.

violations.what: The screen tells the partner a post will NOT go out when it will. queueOne() reads the time box; if the user clears an existing time the box yields null, so postWrite sends scheduled_for:null. The server does `scheduled_for = COALESCE($2::timestamptz, scheduled_for)` (api/social/posts.mjs:70) and with `when = body.scheduled_for || row.scheduled_for` the OLD time is preserved. But the caption is built from the local `when` variable, not from the server's reply, so it prints 'Saved. That post is waiting, but it has no send time, so it will not go out on its own.' while the row still has a send time and will send. The re-rendered table then contradicts the caption. Same code path also means a send time can never actually be cleared, though the editable box invites exactly that.
violations.evidence: qActMsg(when ? 'Saved. That post is waiting and set for ' + fmt(when) + '.' : 'Saved. That post is waiting, but it has no send time, so it will not go out on its own.');  — paired with api/social/posts.mjs:68-72 `const when = body.scheduled_for || row.scheduled_for;` and `scheduled_for = COALESCE($2::timestamptz, scheduled_for)`

violations.what: The replacement empty-state caption contradicts the unit's own documented gap on the same screen. It now says posts 'can still be written' with zero connected accounts, but the composer on that same page refuses to save a hand-typed post with zero accounts — the unit's own leftUndone says so, and I verified it (api/social/schedule.mjs:32 `if (!channelId) return res.status(400)... channel_id_required`; api/social/posts.mjs has no create branch; the only INSERT is api/social/generate.mjs:107). Only the AI writer can put a post in the list. One false sentence was replaced with a second, softer false sentence, and the composer's refusal message is the only place the truth appears.
violations.evidence:
'
Posts can still be written, given a send time and thrown away without one. They wait in the list '+ ... vs line 1980 'There is no account to post to, so a post typed here cannot be saved yet.'

violations.what: The 12 new tests do not test the fix and cannot fail against the old code. `git status --porcelain api/social/` is empty — this unit changed no server file. The tests import api/social/posts.mjs and exercise it directly; that handler is byte-identical to HEAD. Both user-visible changes (the browser now calling the endpoint, and the Generate card no longer being hidden by gateLinks) have zero automated coverage. The manifest is honest that the endpoint 'already did' the work, but the testsAdded list is presented as evidence for the fix and is not.
violations.evidence: import postsApi from "../../api/social/posts.mjs"; — and `git status --porcelain api/social/` returns nothing. Reproduced 12/12 pass against fundhub_t10_d; the same 12 pass on HEAD.

violations.what: Raw server error codes are printed straight to a non-technical user, against CLAUDE.md §10 (plain language, no jargon). A 404 has no `message` field, so the screen shows literally 'Not saved: not_found' / 'Not thrown away: not_found'.
violations.evidence: qActMsg('Not saved: ' + (res.message || res.error || 'the server refused it'));  — api/social/posts.mjs:105 returns { ok:false, error:"not_found" } with no message key. Same at line 1028.

violations.check: 12 — DID IT ACTUALLY DO THE JOB (partial, not a defect in the code)
violations.what: Not a code defect — a scope note the orchestrator must not lose. The Creative Factory fix removes the symptom on one screen; the landmine in shell.js gateLinks() is untouched and unguarded. Any other public/app/*.html with an in-content anchor inside a .card silently deletes that whole card for roles that cannot open the target, with no console message. The unit reports this as a blocker and checked only its own two files (I confirmed both now have zero non-sidebar anchors).
